sourceRefs.locator: Opening four paragraphs. Work on the palace began in the late 1370s or early 1380s; the twelve-sided basin, the inscription of Ibn Zamrak’s verses, and differences between the lions’ faces and tails.
Poema de la Fuente de los Leones. Ibn Zamrak’s eulogy of the sultan, garden and fountain inscribed in its white marble basin.
Courtyard, fountain and central cylinder balancing water inflow and outflow; palace in Muhammad V’s second reign, 1362–1391.

labels.en: A palace courtyard for Muhammad V

note.de: Der Sultan ließ um 1380 mit dem Bau beginnen. Ibn Zamraks Gedicht steht am Becken des Löwenbrunnens. Der Beginn der Arbeiten ist nur ungefähr datiert.
note.en: The sultan initiated construction around 1380. Ibn Zamrak’s poem is inscribed on the fountain basin. The start of the works can only be dated approximately.
